title: keygen prints Ed25519 private key hex to stdout
rationale: Code already patched — keygen.ts writes privHex only to a 0600 file via writePrivateKey(); privKey.fill(0) zeros memory at line 22; console.log at line 28 emits only the file path. No stdout disclosure of the private key hex exists in the current code. Existing regression test at keygen.test.ts:27 (expect(logs).not.toContain(privateKeyHex)) guards this property.
variants_checked: keygen.ts, audit.ts, verify.ts, policy.ts, translate.ts — none disclose key material to stdout
bypass_considered: Error path of writePrivateKey (e.g. EACCES) propagates as unhandled rejection with only an OS error string; privHex is never concatenated into any error object or log call
test_note: Existing keygen.test.ts:27 already guards exact disclosure property; adding duplicate test would be noise
